claim: A prospectively frozen output-matrix-only hard-negative margin pilot replayed exactly and remained numerically safe, but failed to generalize from its 64-window preflight: full-audit target rank worsened by 910 per mille and public development NLL regressed by 2,004,452 millibits, so public test and open-generation confirmation stayed closed.
